Eli Ramos: Heads up — seeing assistant/system role bleed after our HF Jinja chat_template -> Redwood conversion for the new Mistral variant. Outputs sometimes include leftover Jinja braces and an extra <|assistant|> token in the middle of responses.
Sara K: ugh. repro data? small example?
Eli Ramos: minimal repro: template has a conditional block like `{% if persona %}{{ persona }}\n{% endif %}` and when persona is empty we still end up with an extra newline and a sentinel token gets split by tokenizer after quantization.
Mike L: that smells like special token mapping + tokenizer fallback splitting. which tokenizer are you using? hf/llama-tokenizer?
Eli Ramos: hf->transformers/gpt-neox-ish vocabs. config.json had `add_special_tokens: {"bos_token": "<|bos|>", "eos_token": "<|eos|>", "additional_special_tokens": ["<|assistant|>", "<|system|>"]}` but during conversion we canonicalize to Redwood sentinels `<system>` `<assistant>` and the regex we use does `replace(/<\|(.+?)\|>/g, '<$1>')`. That works normally but with quantized model the tokenizer splits `<|assistant|>` into `<|ass` `istant|>` sometimes.
Jamie: split tokens on quantized builds is expected if special tokens aren't in the tokenizer's merges/vocab. Did we add the special tokens to the tokenizer before quant?
Eli Ramos: we thought we did — conversion script calls `tokenizer.add_special_tokens(...)` but the HF config get overwritten by our config import step. So add_special_tokens ran, but later `from_pretrained` with remote config replaced the tokenizer files.
Sara K: can we fix by patching the converter to persist the special token list to the final tokenizer files (vocab.json/merges) and validate membership before quantize?
Mike L: yes. quick fix: after all file ops, run `for t in special: if not tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(t): tokenizer.add_special_tokens({"additional_special_tokens": [t]})` and then save_pretrained. Also add unit test that asserts `tokenizer.tokenize('<|assistant|>')` returns single token.
Eli Ramos: I tried a local hack — added a post-convert validation step and reran our 4-bit quant build. Tokenizer now keeps `<|assistant|>` intact. But we still saw role bleed in a few eval prompts.
Jamie: could be templating whitespace or empty-blocks producing stray newlines which RL prompt parser treats as content, and then the runtime attaches BOS role markers incorrectly. Did the Jinja prerender collapse lines?
Eli Ramos: yes. Jinja `trim_blocks`+`lstrip_blocks` were on for some templates. For empty values we ended up with `\n<system>` on its own line which the Redwood prompt formatter then re-interpreted as a content token rather than a role separator in some edge cases.
Sara K: so two failure modes: (1) tokenizer missing special tokens => split tokens in quantized model; (2) prerender whitespace + formatter fragility => role markers appear inline. Both together cause assistant/system bleed.
Mike L: propose this roadmap: (a) converter: persist specials and validate tokenization (b) renderer: ensure we collapse empty lines and strip standalone sentinels before handing to runtime (c) eval: add a small test-suite covering sentinel integrity across float/8bit/4bit quantized builds.
Jamie: agree. also add a heuristic in Redwood prompt formatter: if a sentinel token appears in the middle of a text chunk and its token id is not in the tokenizer's special set, raise a warn and fallback to canonical role split.
Eli Ramos: I'll open a PR with converter patch + unit test. For the evals I'll add a micro-benchmark: feed a set of templated prompts with empty/filled persona fields into hosted vs quantized dedicated and compare role-correctness/stripping. Metric: fraction of outputs with extra role tokens.
Sara K: add automated regression alert in Optimize for this eval so future model bring-ups flag it.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: converter/patch/1958765460 -> staging (CI passed) :rocket:
Mike L: sweet. after PR lands we should re-run the Mistral quantization sweep and post a short note in #eng-ml with before/after numbers.
Eli Ramos: thanks all. I'll try to keep the repro minimal and attach the exact template + tokenizer logs in the PR.
Sara K: cheers :thumbsup:
